verses: Bring water from the distant pool, And let it settle in a jar. Millet or rice 'twill steam--such use May come from things that paltry are. You are our happy, courteous king; On you a noble duty lies. Father and mother, joined in one, With all the people sympathize!

Bring water from the distant pool, And let it settle in a jar. A spirit vase 'twill wash;--such use May come from things that paltry are. You are our happy, courteous king, Born subject to a noble law. Like center to which all should turn, So you the people ever draw.

Bring water from the distant pool, And let it settle in a jar. All things 'twill serve to cleanse;--such use May come from things that paltry are. You are our happy, courteous king, Set to fulfill a noble end. The center in which all have rest, The people's hearts to you should tend.
